verdict.rationale: Render advertises a 'Coding agents' integration page and AI-friendly docs (llms.txt, docs.md) plus a REST API/CLI that agents could call, hinting at natural-language/agentic operation, but there is no concrete evidence of a chat or NL command interface actually letting users operate Render conversationally. missing for 10: dedicated NL/chat interface, first-party agent skill demos, independent confirmation of NL-driven deployments.
